title: All‑Staff Rehearsal Script + Priorities Map (Q2 prep)
content:
Purpose:
Runbook and rehearsal script for the upcoming All‑Staff (target week of Q2 kickoff).
This doc is the single source for the run‑of‑show, speaker cues, objectives snapshot, escalation paths, and post‑allstaff followups. Meant to be light for rehearsals and detailed for comms owners.

TL;DR:
- High‑priority: announce Q2 north star + 3 cross‑company OKRs, clarify Dedicated sales runway, and preview Private deployment pilot support.
- Ask each org for 1 measurable customer outcome tied to OKR 2 (Reliability & SLOs).
- Rehearsal cadence: 3 dry runs (lead, tech, final with founders). Owners: Maya (MC), Diego (slides + timing), Rhea (executive prep).

Run‑of‑Show (90 minutes total) — timestamps are minutes from start:
0–5: Welcome & context (MC — Maya)
5–15: Where we are (Founders townline — Raj/Claudia) — 2 slides: progress v. plan, big bets
15–30: Q2 North Star + 3 company OKRs (Product + CEO) — walk brief OKR card for each objective
30–45: Dedicated + Private product preview (PM leads) — 1 minute product demo clip, 2 customer signals
45–60: Reliability & Cost playbook (Infra/SRE) — announce new SLOs and rollout plan; call for org commits
60–70: Customer & Revenue highlights (GTM) — top 3 wins and one risk
70–80: People & Ops updates (People Ops + Finance) — hiring forecast + spending guardrails
80–90: Q&A (moderated) + close (MC)

Speaker Cues (short lines, rehearse verbatim):
- Maya (MC): "Welcome — three headlines for today: what we commit to, who owns it, how we’ll measure it."
- Founders: "We’ve shipped runway; now we optimize for predictable inference economics at scale."
- PM lead (Dedicated): "This quarter we muddy no waters: predictable throughput at committed price points."
- SRE lead: "We’ll measure by 99p latencies on active routes and a new incident SLA for model fallbacks."

OKR Draft Snapshot (for readout slide; keep each KR measurable):
Objective A — Deliver predictable inference economics for scale customers
- KR A1: 20% reduction in median per‑token cost for top 10 hosted routes
- KR A2: Ship Dedicated autoscale + burst config and onboard 3 customers to reserved pools
- KR A3: Cost per request SLA exposed to customers for top 5 models

Objective B — Raise reliability and graceful degradation across deployments
- KR B1: 99.5% uptime on Dedicated clusters per month (measured at routing layer)
- KR B2: Implement automated fallback policy on 3 model families with <5% degraded answers
- KR B3: Decrease mean time to detect (MTTD) for model regressions by 50% through eval hooks

Objective C — Improve developer velocity and adoption of Redwood tooling
- KR C1: 30% increase in active SDK integrations (teams using SDK > 2 calls/day)
- KR C2: Launch Optimize recommendations pilot to 50 internal workloads and show 10% token savings
- KR C3: Publish 8 deep‑dive API/playbook docs and 4 reference apps

Priority asks for each org (one line each) — to collect pre‑reads before rehearsals:
- Eng‑Serving‑Runtime: confirm fallback policy rollout plan + owner (deadline: Mar 15)
- Product (Hosted & Dedicated): finalize canary gating metrics (deadline: Mar 10)
- SRE: validate incident SLA text and enforcement plan (deadline: Mar 12)
- GTM: prepare three customer testimonials (deadline: Mar 18)
- People Ops: confirm hiring freeze exceptions and prioritization (deadline: Mar 14)

Contingency scenarios & canned responses (prep for MC and comms):
- If a demo fails: "We’ll follow up with an on‑demand recording; the release is still on track. Post‑mortem to come."
- If founders need to pivot: keep the narrative to three things (commit, owner, measure).
- If a security query arises live: defer — "We’ll push a secure FAQ after the meeting; security leads will co‑author."

Escalation Tree (phone+slack ready):
- Level 1 (blocking rehearsal issue): Diego Chen (pager) — mobile +1 (650) 555‑0123, Slack @diego
- Level 2 (content dispute): Rhea Kapoor — mobile +1 (650) 555‑0199, Slack @rhea
- Level 3 (exec/PR escalation): Claudia (CEO office) — mobile listed in executive roster

Rehearsal Plan (dates):
- Dry run 1: Mar 10 — core speakers + slides sync (45m)
- Dry run 2: Mar 17 — full run‑through with video + A/V check (60m)
- Final: Mar 24 — founders + comms + MC (30m)

A/V & Logistics checklist (Tech owner: Liam O'Connor):
- Presentation deck uploaded to live slides (owner: Diego)
- Mic check for remote speakers; confirm echo cancellation (owner: Liam)
- Recording + auto‑publish to internal channel (owner: Comms)
- On‑call tech person available 30min before event (owner: SRE)

Communications plan (pre / during / post):
- Pre: short pre‑read email 48h prior with the three big asks + links to OKR canvas and customer notes. Owner: Comms (Samir).
- During: live production notes and a pinned thread in #allstaff. Owner: MC & Comms.
- Post: summary email with action tracker, owners, deadlines; publish recording and FAQs within 24h. Owner: Comms + Ops.

Post‑Allstaff Action Tracker (template columns: action | owner | due | status):
- Action: Publish SLOs and rollout schedule | Owner: SRE (TBD) | Due: 2 weeks | Status: todo
- Action: Provide Dedicated pricing commitment language | Owner: Product + Finance | Due: 1 week | Status: todo
- Action: Start Optimize pilot roster; select internal workloads | Owner: Optimize PM | Due: 3 weeks | Status: todo

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep the founders' opening to max 3 minutes. They tend to overindex on roadmap detail.
- Audience will want clarity on costs; have a single slide that maps actions -> $ impact (high/med/low).
- Watch for 'private deployment' legal phrasing; security should pre‑approve any customer examples.

Unresolved questions (need answers before final run):
- Do we agree to the KR thresholds listed above?
- Which 3 customers will be highlighted (GTM to confirm)?
- Who signs off on the SLA wording (legal or SRE)?

Next steps (owners):
- Diego: finalize deck + timing, Mar 5
- Rhea: prep founders notes + 1‑page brief, Mar 7
- Liam: run A/V checklist and confirm recording method, Mar 12
- Maya: finalize final run order and MC script, Mar 17

Appendix (quick references):
- Confluence: company OKR canvas (CONFLUENCE-1234)
- JIRA: event logistics board (JIRA-OPS-789)
- Slack: rehearsal channel #allstaff-rehearsal

——
If you’re reading this and want to change the order/priority of any section, please ping Rhea or Maya directly. This is a working doc — expect edits up to the final rehearsal.

End of doc.
